method: Hash every inventory file against the frozen baseline; scan all bytes, including both working-tree patches and all HTML payloads.

Supplement with CLI credential arguments, installer token arguments, IBAN checksum validation, and contextual email/address classification.

Run local Tesseract OCR on 50 unique inventory screenshots and all five additional archived screenshots. Two archive OCR authorization matches were the prose heading 'Basic' followed by OCR-joined words, not authentication data.
